items.title: Carmen Caramanica interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, July 27, 2011
items.q: I had the pleasure of teaching Joe Bonamassa for a summer.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well any students that are out there now performing that you gave some knowledge to? Any guys from Utica that sort of have made it in the biz?

Well the obvious, I had the pleasure of teaching Joe Bonamassa for a summer. And I never take any credit for his success or his ability because he did it by himself. And by the time his dad brought him to me he was like eleven years old and said “I want you to give him some direction.” After we played for ten minutes I said “he’s got his direction, we’re just going to play together.” And so he would come in and we’d jam once a week and I’d tell him how great he was and made no effort — I mean I tried to just tell…
Yeah. Well, thank you for your time today. It’s been really fascinating. All right?
